resources.string: A 24 hour dial of the world\'s exchange trading sessions.
The session dial without the band labels, for two cells.
Bands and hands only, for a single cell.
A 24 hour dial of the world\'s stock exchange sessions, as a home screen widget. Green bands are trading now, grey bands are the next session. Tap the widget to open the full web app.
All three sizes stay resizable once placed, and they also appear in your launcher\'s own widget picker.
Android is not letting this app schedule exact alarms, so the dial hands may lag by a few minutes. The digital time keeps ticking either way.
Zero turns that side off. With both at zero nothing is scheduled.
Nothing is selected to begin with: all fourteen markets on both bells would be over fifty notifications a day.
Alerts are scheduled with exact alarms. Without that permission they can arrive minutes late.
Notifications are blocked for this app, so alerts cannot be shown. Allow them in Settings.
Opening and closing bells for the markets you choose.
Your launcher cannot add widgets this way. Long press the home screen, choose Widgets, then find Market Sessions.
